authorization: Owner approved 11 November 2026: synthetic evaluation with existing DebugBundle report credential; USD 1 and 40 paid requests maximum; activation only after safety/usefulness pass.
review: All final cases passed application validation and manual review for evidence specificity, recorded linkage only, falsifiable checks and bounded verification. Restricted guidance stays at signal level. Full mode uses supplied symptoms, separates linked reliability and measured friction, and makes no causal or improvement guarantee. Resolved-only final case returns no investigations; low traffic checks measurement instead of proposing marketing or UI changes.
fixture_correction: Five initial fixtures inherited an incident observation after changing source kind/status. Those paid outcomes are retained for accounting but superseded by internally consistent cases; the final resolved-only case returns no investigation. No production prompt change or paid retry occurred.
offline_checks: model-client test fixtures reject incomplete provider envelope and wrong model without retry

investigations.title: Investigate the open critical incident
checks: Review the retained incident evidence and confirm its current status and whether it is recurring.
Check the available incident evidence for a testable explanation without assuming a cause.
If a bounded change is made, verify it against the incident signal and check for recurrence in a subsequent comparable observation.

investigations.title: Investigate the open checkout payment timeout
checks: Inspect the retained incident and prior investigation evidence; distinguish lifetime occurrences from current activity.
Check current payment timeout status and available diagnostic evidence to confirm or rule out whether the symptom persists.
If a bounded change is made, verify checkout payment behavior with a regression check and a subsequent comparable observation before confirming resolution.

investigations.title: Investigate shipping-step exits
checks: Inspect retained session evidence and checkout instrumentation to establish the affected flow, denominator and sampling limits.
Compare suitably observed segments and check whether exits persist when instrumentation is complete; do not infer friction from exit counts alone.
If a bounded change is warranted, verify it with a regression check and a subsequent comparable observation.

investigations.title: Investigate overlapping check failures
checks: Inspect the retained open incident and the failing monitored checks, distinguishing overlapping check failures from an account-wide outage.
Check current endpoint recovery and compare check results and observation windows to determine whether failures persist.
If a bounded change is warranted, compare subsequent check results and incident status with a comparable observation window, including a regression check for previously successful checks.

investigations.title: Investigate recurring checkout timeout
investigations.hypothesis: The retry path may contribute to the payment submission timeout.
checks: Inspect retained incident details and available timing evidence for payment submission and retry; compare submissions with and without a retry to test the hypothesis.
If a bounded change is identified, verify it with a retry regression check and a subsequent comparable observation; confirm whether the incident remains open.

investigations.title: Assess checkout completion drop
checks: Inspect the completion denominator, sampling, comparable segments and affected checkout flow, accounting for partial coverage.
Assess the recorded incident linkage without assuming causation; compare a subsequent observation using the same coverage and segments before considering a bounded flow change.

investigations.title: Investigate the open critical incident
checks: Inspect the retained incident evidence and clarify the timeout symptom and recurring occurrences; check whether the incident remains active.
Check whether available timing and flow evidence supports or disproves any connection between the timeout and reduced traffic, without assuming a causal link.
If a bounded change is made, verify it with a regression check and a subsequent comparable observation; treat missing observations as unknown.

investigations.title: Investigate the open critical incident
checks: Inspect retained incident details and occurrence history to establish the current symptom and recurrence; treat the occurrence count as lifetime, not period-specific.
Check current incident evidence to confirm whether the failure persists and distinguish it from historical occurrences.
If a bounded change is identified, verify it against the captured symptom and perform a regression check or compare a subsequent observation.

investigations.title: Investigate the open critical incident
checks: Review the retained incident evidence and its current status; treat the recorded count as potentially lifetime rather than a period total.
Check whether the incident remains active and whether recurrence is supported by comparable observations.
If a bounded change is identified, verify recovery and check for regression using subsequent comparable observations.

investigations.title: Investigate the open critical incident
checks: Inspect the retained incident evidence and occurrence history, noting that the reported count is lifetime rather than period-specific.
Check the current failure and available diagnostic evidence to distinguish a recurring failure from a resolved symptom.
If a bounded fix is identified, verify it with a regression check and a subsequent comparable observation; confirm the incident's current status.

investigations.title: Assess traffic evidence
checks: Inspect analytics coverage, sampling, affected flow and available comparable periods or segments; determine whether a meaningful denominator exists before inferring friction.
If a measurement gap is confirmed, verify a bounded instrumentation change with a regression check and a subsequent comparable observation.

investigations.title: Verify retained incident status
checks: Inspect the retained incident record to reconcile the resolved status with the open observation and determine its current status.
If a status correction is warranted, verify it against the incident record and check that it remains consistent on a subsequent review.

investigations.title: Shipping step exits
checks: Inspect retained sessions and checkout instrumentation around the shipping step, including the affected flow and sampling limits.
Check the denominator and coverage before comparing exits across comparable segments; determine whether the available evidence supports a specific friction hypothesis.
If a bounded change is supported, verify it with a regression check and a subsequent comparable observation, retaining the coverage caveat.

investigations.title: Investigate failing monitored checks
checks: Inspect the retained check failures and their observation windows; distinguish overlapping checks from any account-wide outage.
Check current endpoint recovery and compare affected checks with successful checks to establish the scope of the failure.
If a bounded change is made, repeat the affected checks and compare subsequent observations, including checks that previously succeeded, for regression.

investigations.title: Investigate recurring checkout timeouts
checks: Inspect the retained incident and linked improvement, including available details of payment submissions that time out after a retry.
Check whether comparable retry attempts reproduce the timeout and whether submissions without a retry show the same symptom.
Verify any bounded change with a retry regression check and a subsequent comparable observation of the timeout signal.

investigations.title: Examine the checkout completion drop
checks: Inspect the completion denominator, sampling, segment coverage and affected checkout flow before considering a flow change.
Compare covered segments and periods where traffic and sampling are comparable; check whether the observed drop persists without treating the incident link as proof of cause.
Verify any bounded change with a checkout regression check and a subsequent comparable completion observation.

investigations.title: Assess the traffic signal
checks: Inspect retained visit observations and coverage to establish the denominator and sampling limits.
Check whether comparable periods, segments and affected flows are available; do not infer friction from low traffic alone.
If a bounded measurement change is warranted, check for regressions in coverage and compare a subsequent observation using the same sampling and segment definitions.
